implementation: Existing six probe modes, fixtures, references, GPU flags and correctness gates are unchanged.
Reuses tested actual Response.clone and successful WASM instantiation witness, not URL or file-only identity.
Pins raw unified fixture source and HEAD, explicit helper inputs, WASM closure, full Chromium closure and actual resolved runtime package dependency graph before and after each case.
Prepare does not launch a browser; run requires separately allocated exclusive browser/GPU window.
Fresh group and attempt receipts; first failed mode stops without retry, cap, skip or silent promotion. Failure logs and after-failure identity are retained.
Unit fixture cleanup unlinks only known created files and removes only empty directories; no recursive cleanup of unrelated entries.

controls: raw source drift and wrong HEAD
actual cyclic toolchain resolution, unavailable optional dependency and missing required dependency
cpuVerification.focusedRecommendedEslint: passed for five new JS files
cpuVerification.strictUtf8: passed for five new JS files

historicalCpuPrepare.boundary: CPU preparation only, not an acceptance result. Later helper/test edits supersede this plan; create a fresh plan after unified save and manifest refresh.

limitations: Standalone Chromium WebGPU/SwiftShader only, not installed Electron or all hardware
No Host Bun identity claim for this browser-only six-mode lane
Does not replace pending MV, model, Particle, object exports or epkg/E2E acceptance
